content.name: Ritu Malhotra
content.title: Head of Learning Support Assistants and Senior Co-Teacher
content.summary: Learning support professional with 14 years in Delhi NCR schools, moving from assistant teacher to heading a team of 22 co-teachers and shadow teachers in an IB PYP school. RCI-registered special educator who built the school's inclusion programme, now supporting 85 students with learning needs.

experience.title: Assistant Teacher, Pre-Primary
bullets: Assisted the class teacher in a nursery class of 25, preparing Montessori materials and running small-group phonics.
Observed and recorded developmental milestones for each child, sharing notes at quarterly parent meetings.
Planned the annual day performance for 120 children.

experience.title: Shadow Teacher (Special Needs)
bullets: Supported 3 students with autism and ADHD in mainstream classes, adapting worksheets and managing sensory breaks.
Worked with the school counsellor on individual education plans reviewed every term with parents.
Helped one student move from full-day shadow support to half-day support within two years.

experience.title: Senior Co-Teacher, IB PYP
bullets: Co-taught Grade 3 with the homeroom teacher, leading inquiry stations and small-group literacy for 28 students.
Introduced a weekly reading assessment that identified 14 students for early intervention.
Kept 85% of students with learning needs attending live sessions during remote learning in 2020–21.
Trained 9 new co-teachers on PYP planners and differentiation strategies.

experience.title: Head of Learning Support Assistants
bullets: Lead 22 co-teachers and shadow teachers across Grades 1–8 and manage a support budget of ₹38 lakh a year.
Built the school's inclusion programme, now supporting 85 students with IEPs and termly progress reviews.
Cut co-teacher attrition from 30% to 12% by setting up a training calendar, mentoring and a clear growth path.
Run parent workshops on dyslexia and ADHD attended by 300+ parents each year.

education.degree: Diploma in Education (Special Education – Learning Disability)

education.school: Lady Shri Ram College for Women, University of Delhi

courses.name: IB PYP Category 1 Workshop: Making the PYP Happen

achievements.title: RCI registration
achievements.detail: Registered with the Rehabilitation Council of India as a special educator since 2015.

achievements.title: Inclusion programme
achievements.detail: Grew support from 20 to 85 students with IEPs in four years.
